categories.old_units: opaque track string, rounded milliseconds, and encoded-file SHA-256 cache key

categories.normalization_semantics: Pilot critic vectors divide BPM by 200 and use floating values; v2 stores unnormalized integer millibpm and ppm

categories.new_units: integer ppm activity/density/collision and boolean click-safety, all window-local

categories.normalization_semantics: Pilot critic clips/scales onset density and log-scales flux; those vector transforms are not v2 measurement semantics

categories.old_units: whole-source fractional STFT power below 250 Hz
categories.new_units: integer ppm window-local bass occupancy and pair collision

categories.old_units: whole-source fractions, Hz means, and mean positive STFT-magnitude delta
categories.new_units: integer ppm window-local occupancies, stability, and aligned pair overlap

categories.normalization_semantics: Pilot critic scales Hz and log-scales flux; v2 uses raw integer ppm ratios from its declared algorithm
